within_policy_control: Original versus raw-tapped y/tap23_out and all eight post-call states must be raw-byte exact for both policies and both chunks; original replay must equal pinned CPU-input/CPU-cache factorial outputs and states.
previous_tap_control: Also compare the four shared taps against the prior four-tap run under the same policy and chunk; record this separately from the endpoint/state gate.
